title: A Rigorous Proof of Metric Blow-Up for Pseudospherical Metrics Associated with the Degasperis--Procesi Equation
summary: This paper studies finite-time blow-up of pseudospherical metrics induced by solutions of the Cauchy problem for the Degasperis--Procesi equation. For initial momentum profiles satisfying suitable left--right sign conditions, we use the method of characteristics, the momentum-transport formula, the Green's-function representation, and Riccati-type differential inequalities to analyze the metric along a distinguished characteristic.
